title: The Ordinary will close on Black Friday to prioritise blood donations over ‘hyperconsumerism’
summary: The Estée Lauder companies-owned skin care brand is hosting The Ordinary Blood Drive in the US and Canada on Black Friday (27 November) to encourage donations and ‘expand access to this life-saving resource’, with complementary initiatives taking place in the UK and Denmark

title: Sephora eyes ten more UK stores in 2027 to accelerate growth
summary: The LVMH-owned beauty retailer is allegedly planning to open ten more UK stores next year, taking its total store count in the region to 28, according to a new report that cites property sources

title: Meet the Maestro: For perfumer Abdulla Ajmal, fragrance is in his blood
summary: Abdulla Ajmal has worked for more than 30 years in the Middle Eastern fragrance business. He delves into why oud is more than just a buzzword, and how his brand Ajmal Perfumes will continue to iterate its scent offering

title: How to make an eyelash serum: IFF shares its formulation insights
summary: As consumer demand for lash growth serums rises, Morgane Piet explores how to formulate a serum designed to condition lashes and improve strength, length and thickness

title: L’Occitane’s Managing Director UK and Ireland departs after four years
summary: Dianne Tieu, L’Occitane’s Managing Director for the UK and Ireland, has confirmed she is departing the beauty company following four years at the helm

title: E.l.f. Beauty and Twitch break GRWM Guinness World Record
summary: E.l.f. Beauty partnered with streaming service Twitch to hold the world’s largest ‘get ready with me’ at Twitchcon, breaking a world record in the process

title: Rhode unveils first matte blush in founder Hailey Bieber’s 30th birthday collection
summary: The e.l.f. Beauty-owned brand is launching a limited-edition navy capsule this month to mark founder Bieber’s 30th birthday, featuring Rhode’s first-ever matte blush Pocket Plush and first piece of wearable merchandise – an £148 Reversible Windbreaker

title: The naked nail trend: how skinification is reshaping nail care
summary: As the naked nail trend becomes a status symbol, new formats and skin care ingredients are putting nail health products in the spotlight

title: RevitaLash Cosmetics expands Length Define Tubing Mascara Collection with new dark brown shade
summary: RevitaLash Cosmetics, renowned innovators in the lash, brow, and hair care categories, proudly announces the expansion of its award-winning Length Define Tubing Mascara with the launch of a new Dark Brown shade
